<script>
(() => {
  if (window.__GEEKMAIL_AUTO_SYNC_PATCH__) return;
  window.__GEEKMAIL_AUTO_SYNC_PATCH__ = true;

  let armed = false;
  let timer = null;

  function csvFiles(files) {
    return [...(files || [])].filter(file => file?.name?.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv'));
  }

  function shouldAutoSync(files) {
    const csvs = csvFiles(files);
    if (!csvs.length) return false;
    // Files generated by "Load DB" are only for feeding the existing viewer.
    // Do not write those straight back to Supabase.
    return !csvs.every(file => /^supabase-geekmail-/i.test(file.name));
  }

  function arm(files) {
    if (!shouldAutoSync(files)) return;
    armed = true;
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!armed) return;
      const modal = document.querySelector('#gmDeltaContent');
      const merge = document.querySelector('#gmMergeSync');
      const loading = document.querySelector('#gmDeltaLoading');
      const comparisonReady = modal && modal.style.display !== 'none' && merge && !merge.disabled;
      const comparisonFailed = loading && loading.style.display !== 'none' && /failed|error/i.test(loading.textContent || '');

      if (comparisonFailed) {
        armed = false;
        clearInterval(timer);
        timer = null;
        return;
      }

      if (comparisonReady) {
        armed = false;
        clearInterval(timer);
        timer = null;
        // Default CSV behavior is a safe merge: add new rows and update changed rows.
        // Rows that exist in Supabase but are absent from the CSV are preserved.
        merge.click();
      }
    }, 100);
  }

  const fileInput = document.querySelector('#fileInput');
  fileInput?.addEventListener('change', event => arm(event.target.files));

  const drop = document.querySelector('#drop');
  drop?.addEventListener('drop', event => arm(event.dataTransfer?.files));
})();
</script>
